posts.text: Trump is planning on presenting a plan proposed by JD Vance that would pay one parent in a married couple to be paid for staying home with their child, but only if the parents are married. Unmarried and single parents would be excluded from this program.  The new program would reduce available daycare funding for unmarried and single parents.
posts.summary: Criticizes exclusionary family policy favoring married couples

posts.text: Tarrant County, Texas’s third most populous county, voted to close almost 1/3 of its polling locations right before the midterms.  The county’s republican majority election commission voted in favor of closing 176 polling locations, most of which are in Black and Latino neighborhoods and in college student voter areas.  The measure was approved as a cost saving measure.
posts.summary: Opposes polling place closures targeting Black and Latino voters
